message.content:
Research task for Nxeon (VPS/game-hosting business) — extending the game catalog. No code changes; this is a research/report-back task.

Context: an earlier SEO research pass already identified and the team has since data-scaffolded 5 new games with verified host-owned (beatable) search demand: Dragonwilds (RuneScape: Dragonwilds), Sunkenland, Abiotic Factor, Core Keeper, Icarus. Also already ruled OUT: Pax Dei and Dune Awakening (both official-shard-only, no dedicated server support, so not addable). The owner explicitly said "no GPUs yet" — so no game requiring GPU-accelerated hosting (e.g. no AI/ML-adjacent game servers, no ray-traced anything). The owner wants MORE games researched beyond these 5.

Find candidate games using the SAME criteria that qualified the original 5:
1. Has genuine, official (or at minimum widely-adopted, low-legal-risk) dedicated server support — i.e., you can actually stand up a real multiplayer server for it (SteamCMD app, official server binary, or similarly legitimate route). Skip anything official-shard-only.
2. Real, current player demand — recently popular or trending survival/co-op/sandbox games (the existing catalog leans survival/sandbox: Valheim, Palworld, ARK, Conan Exiles, Enshrouded, etc. — similar genre fits the audience) OR other genres with strong dedicated-server hosting demand (city builders, colony sims, tycoon games with co-op, etc. worth checking too).
3. A "host-owned" SERP: search for hosting-intent keywords like "[game] server hosting" and "[game] dedicated server" and assess whether the results are dominated by mega-authority sites (skip) or beatable peer-tier hosts like Shockbyte/Apex/Bisect/Nodecraft/WinterNode (good — matches the pattern that made the original 5 easy wins).
4. No GPU requirement.

Consider: recently released or recently-patched-with-multiplayer survival/sandbox games from 2025-2026, games with active Steam Workshop/modding communities that also sell hosting well (since Nxeon has a mods-access value prop), and any notable 2026 breakout co-op/survival titles you're aware of or can find via search. Also check if there's demand for older/classic games not yet in the catalog that still have decent search volume (e.g., older Source-engine or established survival titles Nxeon might be missing — cross-check against what's NOT already in the catalog: search `lib/games.ts` at /opt/nxeon-staging for the full existing list first so you don't suggest duplicates).

For each candidate you recommend, report: game name, why it fits (demand signal + SERP beatability + dedicated server support), and any red flags (GPU requirement, official-shard-only, legally murky, or genuinely saturated SERP — exclude these, don't recommend them).

Produce a ranked shortlist (aim for 5-10 solid candidates, don't pad with weak ones) with brief justification each. Under 500 words. No code changes, no catalog edits — pure research/recommendation for the owner to review.

## Official Status

Neither Grounded nor Grounded 2 has an official dedicated server, and Grounded 2 entered Early Access with 4-player co-op and no confirmed plan for official server binaries.

## Current Solutions

Everything called a "Grounded dedicated server" in 2026, including the ones game-server companies rent out, is built on a community framework called Lantern. ## Default Multiplayer Option

Instead of dedicated servers, Grounded uses a "shared world" function where authorized players host the world using peer-to-peer connection, and every player who has played in that world has access to a synced save that any of them can use.

## Hardware Requirements

For 4 players, you need 2–4 cores and 8 GB RAM, with the box placed in the region where your group plays.
